newsitem.title: USA: Amerus Life plans to offer 3.6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Amerus Life plans to offer 3.6 mln shares.

text.p: AmerUs Life Holdings Inc said Thursday it plans to issue about 3.6 million shares of class A common stock in a public offering expected to take place in the fall.
AmerUs said the purpose of the offering is to improve liquidity, maintain flexibility and increase capital to position the company to pursue future potential acquisitions.
AmerUs Group, which owns 72 percent of the 23.2 million shares outstanding, is expected to purchase additional stock of AmerUs Life Holdings in the offering, the company said in a news release.

AmerUs Life Holdings is the parent of AmerUs Life Insurance Company, which markets, underwrites and distributes individual life insurance and annuity products in 45 states and the District of Columbia. The company completed its initial public offering earlier this year.
Earlier today, AmerUs Life Holdings agreed to acquire Delta Life Corp, a Tennessee life insurance company, for $163 million in cash and the assumption of $23 million in debt.
